name: llama.cpp
tagline: Core C/C++ LLM inference engine powering GGUF quantization across CPUs, Apple Silicon, and consumer GPUs.
real_test_summary: Tested compiling and running quantized GGUF models via llama-server on Apple Silicon and CPU-only systems. Delivers maximum hardware efficiency with zero external runtime dependencies.
pros: Runs quantized LLMs on pure CPU, Apple Metal, CUDA, Vulkan, and ROCm
Zero-dependency C/C++ binary with built-in OpenAI-compatible HTTP server
Reference implementation for GGUF quantization and split CPU/GPU offloading
cons: Command-line flags require manual tuning for optimal layer offloading
Built-in web chat interface is minimal compared to Open WebUI
